segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers form the bulk of feedback and overwhelmingly report the bakuchiol formula as gentle, with little to no irritation even for those who react badly to traditional retinol, though a couple say they saw no dramatic results either.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including breastfeeding mothers avoiding retinol, report the serum leaves dry patches softer and more hydrated without irritation.
segments.combination: The one reviewer describing tricky, dry-in-places/oily-in-places combination skin reports the serum balanced both areas, hydrating dry patches without adding shine to the oily T-zone.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother, firmer skin and visibly softer fine lines within one to a few weeks, though several say results were subtle or not yet noticeable on their own fine lines and wrinkles despite otherwise liking the product.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the serum as hydrating, leaving dry patches and generally dry skin feeling softer and plumper.
concerns.redness: Reviewers dealing with redness or rosacea report the serum toned down redness and calmed reactive skin, with no dissenting reports.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report their dark spots lightening with continued use, though the evidence is limited to a small number of reports.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers using it on blemish-prone skin report calmer skin and fewer or smaller breakouts, with no reports of the serum causing new blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer with an oily T-zone reports the serum kept oily areas from looking shinier while still hydrating drier areas.

extraits.texte: I was very excited to try this serum especially since it's so beautifully packaged and the purple serum itself feels luxurious. My concern was to maintain skin, brightness and firmness, and keeping the fine lines under control. I replaced my old serum with this one for over one week and I am saddened to report that my skin is not looking its best since I started using it. I didn't notice it is very hydrating, but beyond that I don't think that it did anything for my skin in the almost 2 weeks I tested it. That said, I appreciate that the serum uses bakuchiol, a plant-based alternative to retinol that's generally more gentle. It's possible it might take longer to show results for some people, but in my case, I didn't see the benefits that others have described. Complimentary from herbivorebotanicals

I have tricky skin that's dry in some areas but oily in others, and the Herbivore Bakuchiol Dual-Retinol Alternative Serum has really helped balance it out. The bakuchiol + bakuchiol ester give me all the smoothing, retinol-like benefits without irritation or dryness. Glycerin and tremella mushroom extract keep my dry patches soft and hydrated, while never making my oily T-zone greasy. I've also noticed firmer, more even skin thanks to ginseng and Chios mastic resin, and the turmeric root extract has really helped calm redness and brighten my tone. My skin feels smoother, looks more even, and finally feels balanced, hydrated where it needs to be and less shiny where it tends to get oily. Gifted by HerbivoreBotanicals.
